policy: Adopt only when a seeded defect is detected with acceptable noise, runtime, ownership, and non-overlapping value; numeric aggregate scores are prohibited.

candidates.name: actionlint
reason: detected the seeded invalid step
found a real unsafe expression in release verification
syntax and expression checks complement security analysis

pilot.false_positive_assessment: No false positives in the five real workflows.

functional_fit.solves_required_problem: Validates GitHub Actions syntax, expressions, and common shell contracts.

project_fit.compatible_with_current_stack: Directly audits the existing GitHub workflow suite.
project_fit.integration_surface: One digest-pinned binary and one wrapper.
project_fit.architecture_alignment: Hardens current CI rather than replacing it.

maturity.tests: Seed plus all five project workflows.

security.security_history: No pilot issue; release digest is verified.
security.network_access: Only first download; analysis is offline.
security.supply_chain_risk: Single upstream binary pinned by SHA-256.

ownership.maintainer_bus_factor: Focused upstream maintainer with contributor activity.
ownership.upgrade_cost: Refresh version, asset digests, and seed.
ownership.exit_strategy: Remove wrapper/manifest entry and retain valid workflows.

engineering_cost.custom_build_cost: A custom Actions parser would be unjustified.

agent_fit.context7_support: Not needed; upstream CLI docs are authoritative.

candidates.name: zizmor
reason: detected dangerous trigger, template injection, mutable action, and credential persistence in the seed
found four real template-injection paths and checkout hardening gaps
security findings do not duplicate actionlint's syntax focus

pilot.false_positive_assessment: Low-confidence findings are suppressed by the adopted medium-confidence gate.

functional_fit.solves_required_problem: Static security analysis for GitHub Actions.
functional_fit.unnecessary_features: Auto-fix exists but is not enabled.

project_fit.architecture_alignment: Adds security evidence to existing CI.

maturity.tests: Adversarial seed and complete workflow scan.
maturity.production_usage_signal: Sponsored security tool with broad CI use.

security.security_history: Security analyzer; release digest is verified.
security.supply_chain_risk: Standalone Rust binary pinned by SHA-256.

ownership.upgrade_cost: Refresh exact release and rerun seed/noise checks.
ownership.exit_strategy: Remove tool entry while preserving remediated workflows.

operations.observability: Audit IDs, confidence, severity, and exact lines.

engineering_cost.custom_build_cost: Custom security rules would miss upstream audits.

agent_fit.context7_support: Not required for the CLI contract.

candidates.name: pinact
reason: detected the seeded mutable ref
all five real workflows already passed
zizmor already enforces unpinned uses and the existing workflows require reviewable manual pin changes

pilot.false_positive_assessment: No false positives, but insufficient non-overlapping value.

functional_fit.solves_required_problem: Checks and can update immutable Action references.
functional_fit.unnecessary_features: Networked update/autofix is outside the required gate.

project_fit.integration_surface: Another binary and optional GitHub API access.

security.permissions_required: Read-only offline; API token for update features.

ownership.exit_strategy: No adoption; rerun a future pilot if annotation/update needs emerge.

candidates.name: dependency-cruiser
reason: detected the seeded frontend-to-private-backend import
enforces architecture boundaries that Graphify explains but does not deny
real graph passed after rules distinguished project-local Convex modules from the Convex client package

pilot.seeded_defect: local frontend import of a private backend module
pilot.false_positive_assessment: Initial false positives revealed package/local distinction; the refined local-only rule scans 147 modules and 428 dependencies cleanly.

functional_fit.solves_required_problem: Deterministically denies dependency boundaries and cycles.

project_fit.compatible_with_current_stack: Current Node and TypeScript are supported.
project_fit.integration_surface: Pinned dev dependency and one config.
project_fit.architecture_alignment: Enforces the canonical Convex and legacy-stack boundary.

security.supply_chain_risk: 18 direct development dependencies; npm audit clean.

ownership.upgrade_cost: Re-run seeded and real graph checks.
ownership.exit_strategy: Remove dependency/config and retain Graphify evidence.

operations.runtime_cost: About six seconds for the real graph.
operations.observability: Named rule and import path diagnostics.

engineering_cost.custom_build_cost: A custom TypeScript import resolver would be costly and weaker.

candidates.name: Promptfoo
reason: single deterministic exec-provider case timed out after 244 seconds on cold start
29 MB unpacked package with 80 direct dependencies
no native Antigravity provider, so the existing wrapper remains necessary
native repository runner already proves zero-injection controls and exact host behavior

pilot.false_positive_assessment: No result before the bounded timeout; no second round justified.

functional_fit.solves_required_problem: Can express deterministic assertions and shell providers.
functional_fit.unnecessary_features: Large provider/dashboard/red-team surface is unnecessary for ten native canaries.

project_fit.integration_surface: Would still require custom Codex and Antigravity wrappers.

security.security_history: Not investigated further after fit/runtime rejection.
security.permissions_required: Exec providers inherit local command permissions.
security.secret_handling: Could use authenticated host sessions but adds another command surface.

ownership.upgrade_cost: Frequent broad releases and wrapper compatibility.
ownership.exit_strategy: Keep the current zero-dependency native runner.

operations.runtime_cost: Exceeded four-minute command budget on one echo case.
operations.infrastructure_required: None required, but substantial local package surface.
operations.observability: Rich when it runs; no output in bounded pilot.

engineering_cost.adaptation_cost: Two host wrappers plus config migration.
engineering_cost.custom_build_cost: Already paid as a narrow, working runner.

agent_fit.deterministic_testability: Assertions are deterministic, but the bounded runner did not complete.

candidates.name: MCP Inspector
reason: official protocol client
caught the missing Graphify MCP runtime extra
proved inventories, schemas, calls, and deterministic failure behavior

pilot.false_positive_assessment: Protocol results were valid; Windows Context7 teardown warning is retained.

project_fit.integration_surface: Pinned dev dependency and one certifier.
project_fit.architecture_alignment: Tests current MCPs instead of creating a server.

security.supply_chain_risk: Non-trivial dev tree with a deprecated legacy transport warning.

ownership.exit_strategy: Replace with another standard MCP client.

operations.runtime_cost: Nine to twenty-seven seconds per server on the pilot host.

candidates.name: Playwright plus axe-core
reason: seeded unnamed button was detected
real home and estimate routes passed serious/critical WCAG and console checks
supplies browser behavior evidence that unit tests cannot

functional_fit.unnecessary_features: Only Chromium is installed for the initial gate.

project_fit.architecture_alignment: Extends existing verification without replacing Vitest.

maturity.production_usage_signal: Widely used browser and accessibility tooling.

security.permissions_required: Local test server and browser only.
security.secret_handling: Inert fail-closed values; no live tenant.
security.network_access: Browser binary download; tests run locally.
security.supply_chain_risk: Pinned dev dependencies and official browser artifact.

ownership.dependency_depth: Moderate dev-only tree plus browser cache.
ownership.upgrade_cost: Browser download and rerun seed/real routes.
ownership.lock_in: Low; tests use standard DOM expectations.
ownership.exit_strategy: Remove config/tests/dependencies and keep unit suite.

operations.runtime_cost: About 46 seconds for three local tests after browser install.
operations.infrastructure_required: Local Next.js server and cached Chromium.
operations.observability: Traces/screenshots on failure plus rule details.

engineering_cost.install_cost: Browser download plus three dev packages.
engineering_cost.adaptation_cost: Small config and bounded route matrix.
engineering_cost.long_term_maintenance_cost: Moderate and justified by unique proof.
